summary: The proposed patch does not correctly address the issue and introduces a behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The patch changes the condition from checking if `__all__` is empty to checking if it is `None`. This will cause all members to be documented when `__all__` is an empty list, which is the opposite of the intended behavior.
There are no tests provided to verify the fix. The patch should include tests to ensure that an empty `__all__` attribute results in no members being documented.
